content.comment_body: Hello, I want to control a hydraulic valve in LWE using a push button. The suggested solution works (the signal changes on the falling edge), but I require a continuous signal while the push button is held down and no action when it's not pressed. In summary, the signal should be active as long as the button is pressed. Thank you for your assistance. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ Split from [product_name] LWE Momentary.

The feature to keep a bit set as long as the key is pressed isn't available in earlier Web Editor versions [version_no]. Only the latest release [version_no] supports this continuous button press functionality.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to control a hydraulic valve using a push button interface through [product_name] Web Editor, specifically needing the output signal to stay active as long as the button is pressed. A response notes that earlier software versions do not support continuous activation, highlighting a version-related limitation in real-time control capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that pressing the button in the Web Editor will keep the signal active and for it to deactivate instantly upon release.
